scene: The glowing corridor opens into a grand transit terminal bustling with departures.
picture: Side-scrolling flat terminal platform. On the far left sits a ticket kiosk. Left, a red rooftop gondola hangs ready. Centre, the Pacific Islander girl stands with sketchbook underarm. Centre right, a brass clockwork carousel train idles on mini-tracks. Far right, an open glass pneumatic tube pod rests upright against the wall.
